targets.rawSql:
SELECT sleep_debt_ms
FROM whoop_sleep
ORDER BY timestamp DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT c.timestamp AS "time", c.strain, r.recovery_score FROM whoop_cycle c JOIN whoop_recovery r ON c.id = r.cycle_id WHERE $__timeFilter(c.timestamp) ORDER BY c.timestamp;
SELECT timestamp AS "time", hrv_rmssd_ms, resting_heart_rate FROM whoop_recovery WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) ORDER BY timestamp;

SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS workout_count
FROM whoop_workout 
WHERE $__timeFilter(start);

SELECT SUM(zone_zero_milli) as zero, SUM(zone_one_milli) as one, SUM(zone_two_milli) as two, SUM(zone_three_milli) as three, SUM(zone_four_milli) as four, SUM(zone_five_milli) as five
FROM whoop_workout
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)

SELECT timestamp, SUM(zone_zero_milli) as zero, SUM(zone_one_milli) as one, SUM(zone_two_milli) as two, SUM(zone_three_milli) as three, SUM(zone_four_milli) as four, SUM(zone_five_milli) as five
FROM whoop_workout
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) 
GROUP BY timestamp
ORDER BY timestamp ASC;

panels.description: Average recovery on days a journal behavior was answered yes, minus days answered no. Journal answers are joined to the recovery of the same cycle. Behaviors with fewer than 3 yes or 3 no answers in the time range are hidden.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  j.question AS "Behavior",
  AVG(c.recovery_score) FILTER (WHERE j.answered_yes)
    - AVG(c.recovery_score) FILTER (WHERE NOT j.answered_yes) AS "Recovery impact"
FROM whoop_export_journal j
JOIN whoop_export_cycle c ON c.cycle_start = j.cycle_start
WHERE $__timeFilter(j.timestamp) AND c.recovery_score IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY j.question
HAVING COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE j.answered_yes) >= 3
   AND COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT j.answered_yes) >= 3
ORDER BY 2;

panels.title: Recovery impact by journal behavior

panels.description: For each journal behavior: how often it was answered, and the difference in the same cycle's recovery, HRV, resting heart rate and sleep performance between yes and no days.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  j.question AS "Behavior",
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE j.answered_yes) AS "Yes",
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT j.answered_yes) AS "No",
  100.0 * AVG(CASE WHEN j.answered_yes THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Yes rate",
  AVG(c.recovery_score) FILTER (WHERE j.answered_yes)
    - AVG(c.recovery_score) FILTER (WHERE NOT j.answered_yes) AS "Δ Recovery",
  AVG(c.hrv_rmssd_ms) FILTER (WHERE j.answered_yes)
    - AVG(c.hrv_rmssd_ms) FILTER (WHERE NOT j.answered_yes) AS "Δ HRV",
  AVG(c.resting_heart_rate) FILTER (WHERE j.answered_yes)
    - AVG(c.resting_heart_rate) FILTER (WHERE NOT j.answered_yes) AS "Δ Resting HR",
  AVG(c.performance_perc) FILTER (WHERE j.answered_yes)
    - AVG(c.performance_perc) FILTER (WHERE NOT j.answered_yes) AS "Δ Sleep perf"
FROM whoop_export_journal j
JOIN whoop_export_cycle c ON c.cycle_start = j.cycle_start
WHERE $__timeFilter(j.timestamp)
GROUP BY j.question
ORDER BY 1;

panels.title: Journal behaviors

panels.description: Journal answers per cycle, placed at the cycle start.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  j.timestamp AS "time",
  j.question AS "metric",
  CASE WHEN j.answered_yes THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS "value"
FROM whoop_export_journal j
WHERE $__timeFilter(j.timestamp)
ORDER BY 1;

panels.title: Journal log

panels.description: Total sleep need and time actually asleep as reported by the Whoop app. The API only exposes the parts of sleep need, the export has the total.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  s.timestamp AS "time",
  s.sleep_need_ms / 3600000.0 AS "Sleep need",
  s.asleep_ms / 3600000.0 AS "Asleep"
FROM whoop_export_sleep s
WHERE $__timeFilter(s.timestamp) AND s.nap = false
ORDER BY 1;
